name: Daily Show Countdown
author: colinedwards308
description: A matrix countdown to a daily time or event date, with separate heading/timer colors, selectable time units, preview, and start/stop commands.

privacy.summary: Displays your countdown through local FPP APIs. Keeps local settings, status and diagnostic logs. Installs open-source rendering packages; adds no remote access or sensors.

collects.what: Countdown run times, target dates, model names, remaining time and diagnostic errors

systemChanges.what: FPP installs python3-pil and fontconfig from the device's configured package repositories.
Starts a background countdown worker on request; stops at completion or Stop. No boot service is installed.

privacy.other: Settings are stored in config/plugin.FPP-Plugin-DailyShowCountdown. Runtime status, lock and stop files are in plugindata/FPP-Plugin-DailyShowCountdown. The plugin uses FPP's existing web server and local overlay API, including activating, drawing on and clearing the selected display model. Status is overwritten each run; logs have no plugin-defined age limit or delete button. Uninstall stops the worker and removes its settings and runtime data, but leaves its log and installed packages. Source for the plugin and its package dependencies is public.
